facts.fact: Maroc.ma, citing MAP, reports that the road-safety agency NARSA's E-ROKHSATI driving licence platform verifies the user's identity through the Mon Identite Numerique service.

MAR.note: No link between civil register and ID system is stated.

facts.fact: Maroc.ma, citing MAP, says personal data processing on the E-ROKHSATI platform respects law 09-08, with data held on secure servers.

MAR.note: The 11 million figure counts driving licences, not people enrolled in the national ID.
No number at birth is mentioned.
Who operates or owns the ID system is not stated.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated; the national drivers database is not said to use it.
Nothing on the national ID system's issuance, biometrics or certification.

facts.fact: Maroc.ma, citing MAP, reports that NARSA's E-ROKHSATI driving licence renewal platform, presented on 24 November 2026, checks the user's identity through the Mon Identite Numerique service.
